Hosur is 40 kilometres from our factory gate. When a procurement manager at a SIPCOT Phase 1 unit or a contractor setting up a site office on the Bangalore–Chennai highway calls us for a porta cabin, we are the closest ISO-certified manufacturer in the picture.

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has made prefab steel structures since 2009. We build MS-frame porta cabins at our Gopasandra facility in Bangalore (560099), load them onto flatbeds, and dispatch directly to your Hosur address. No middlemen, no resellers. The same factory that holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 certification builds and ships your cabin.

Our porta cabin range covers single-room security posts to multi-room contractor offices. Everything is made to order.

What Hosur Buyers Actually Need

Hosur sits inside Krishnagiri district, Tamil Nadu — on the Tamil Nadu–Karnataka border, about 45 kilometres southeast of Electronic City, Bangalore. The SIPCOT Phase 1 Industrial Complex (PIN 635126) on the Old Krishnagiri Road and SIPCOT Phase 2 near Moranapalli (PIN 635109) together form one of South India's most active electronics and auto component manufacturing belts.

Toyota Kirloskar's vendor network, precision engineering firms, and electronics assembly units in this zone need porta cabins for three things: site offices during factory expansion or new construction, security guard rooms at factory gates, and store rooms for tools or consumables at remote sites. None of these uses need a permanent RCC structure — a factory-built steel cabin does the job for a fraction of the cost and is up the same day it arrives.

Outside the SIPCOT zones, Hosur's position on NH 44 (Bangalore–Chennai National Highway) means constant road construction and infrastructure work. Highway project contractors are among our most regular Hosur customers — they need a lockable wired office at each site location.

Specifications

Every SAMAN porta cabin is built on a mild steel frame using IS 2062 grade hollow sections. The frame is welded at our Bangalore factory, surface-treated, and primed before panel fixing begins.

  • Frame: IS 2062 MS hollow section, factory-welded, anti-rust primed
  • Panels: 40mm PUF sandwich panel (standard) or cement fibre board (heavy-duty option)
  • Roofing: GI sheet with heat-reflective coating, suitable for Hosur's summer temperatures
  • Flooring: Anti-skid chequered steel sheet or plywood-over-MS frame
  • Doors: MS single-leaf or double-leaf with lock, or painted wooden door
  • Windows: Sliding glass, fixed mesh vent, or jalousie louvre — your choice
  • Electrical: Optional single-phase wiring, MCB board, switch points, and LED fittings

Standard sizes we deliver to Hosur:

SizeCommon use
8 ft × 6 ftCompact guard post or pump house
10 ft × 8 ftStandard security cabin or tool store
12 ft × 8 ftSupervisor office or sample room
20 ft × 8 ftContractor site office, wired
20 ft × 10 ftLarger office with partition option
40 ft × 8 ftLabour rest room or equipment store

Non-standard lengths and widths are available. If your site has a specific footprint or height restriction, tell us and we build to it.

What You Can Customise

The cabin that leaves our factory is the cabin you described at enquiry — not a generic unit from stock that gets modified on-site.

  • Number of doors and windows, and which type
  • Insulation level — standard 40mm PUF or upgraded for direct-sun sites
  • Electrical fit-out — wiring from entry point, MCB, LED fittings, fan point
  • Air conditioner provision — cut-out, bracket mounting, copper pipe sleeve, drain
  • False ceiling — plywood or PVC panel, with or without recessed lighting
  • Toilet attachment — FRP water tank, flush commode, wash basin, floor drain, tile finish
  • Partition wall — divide one long cabin into two rooms
  • Exterior paint — primer base plus two finish coats in your colour
  • Branding panel — painted name board or signage area on exterior wall

All customisation details are agreed in writing before manufacturing starts. Once production begins, changes are not possible.

Why SAMAN and Not a Local Dealer

A dealer buys a cabin from a manufacturer, marks it up, and sells it to you. You pay the margin and get no direct recourse if something is wrong with the structure.

We are the manufacturer. When you call +91 88616 22859, you are talking to the factory. Your cabin is built under ISO 9001:2015 quality management (Certificate E20250218645). Our structural frame carries a 5-year warranty. Finishing elements carry 1–2 years. The engineered service life of the structure is 20–25 years — which is why SAIL plants, infrastructure contractors, and factory developers use prefab steel cabins as semi-permanent site infrastructure, not just temporary sheds.

We hold NSIC registration (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207), DPIIT recognition (DIPP56005), and GST registration 29ABBCS7101B1ZR. More than 500 projects completed since 2009.

Delivery to Hosur

  • Dispatch point: Gopasandra, Sarjapura Hubli Road, Bangalore 560099
  • Route: NH 44, Bangalore to Hosur — approximately 40 km, under 1 hour
  • Transit: 1 day driving. We target delivery within 3–5 days of dispatch from our factory

The cabin arrives on a flatbed truck. You need a crane or JCB with sufficient reach to lift the cabin off the truck and place it at your site. We advise the correct crane capacity based on your cabin size and weight when you confirm the order. For small cabins (10 ft × 8 ft), a telehandler or rough-terrain forklift is usually sufficient.

No RCC foundation is required for temporary or semi-permanent use. A levelled compacted murrum, a paver block base, or an existing hard surface works fine. If you want anchor bolt fixing for permanent installation, tell us and we include the fixing plate pattern in the base frame design.

Our steel porta cabin is the most requested model for Hosur factory and highway site deliveries. For labour colony and multi-room layouts, our porta cabin units page covers the full range.

We also deliver to nearby South India cities — see porta cabin in Mysore and porta cabin in Coimbatore if you have requirements across multiple locations.

Pricing

We do not publish fixed prices because every cabin is built to your specification and size. The cost of a basic 10 ft × 8 ft security cabin without electrical fit-out is very different from a 20 ft × 10 ft contractor office with AC, partition, false ceiling, and attached toilet.

What affects your price:

  • Cabin size (length × width × height)
  • Panel type (standard PUF vs cement fibre board)
  • Fit-out level (bare structure vs fully wired vs full interior)
  • Number of doors, windows, and special openings
  • Electrical and plumbing work
  • Freight — Hosur is close, so freight is lower than longer routes

Call or send an enquiry with your required size and use. We return a written quotation with a clear line-item breakup within 24 hours. No vague estimates. No hidden charges added at delivery.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you deliver a porta cabin inside SIPCOT Phase 2 Hosur?

Yes. We deliver to SIPCOT Phase 1 (PIN 635126) and SIPCOT Phase 2 Moranapalli (PIN 635109) and all other Hosur addresses. You will need to arrange a gate pass for our delivery vehicle as per your factory's visitor vehicle procedure. Give us the contact name and gate entry timing in advance and we coordinate directly with your site.

How long from order to delivery in Hosur?

Standard sizes with no customisation: 7 to 10 working days to manufacture, then 1 day transit to Hosur. Custom cabins with electrical fit-out, partition, or toilet attachment: 12 to 18 working days manufacture, then 1 day transit. We confirm the exact schedule in writing when you place the order.

What size crane is needed to offload at my Hosur site?

A 10 ft × 8 ft cabin weighs approximately 800 to 1,000 kg. A 20 ft × 10 ft fitted cabin can be 2,000 to 2,500 kg. We provide the weight with your delivery note so you can book the right crane. A 5-tonne mobile crane handles most standard sizes. If your site has low overhead cables or a narrow access road, tell us and we plan accordingly.

Do you provide erection and installation at the Hosur site?

We provide placement coordination and can guide your crane operator by phone during placement. If you need a SAMAN erection team on-site for levelling, anchor bolt fixing, or commissioning of electrical connections, mention this at enquiry stage. We include it in your quotation as a separate item.

Call or Send an Enquiry

For porta cabins in Hosur, SIPCOT, or anywhere along the Bangalore–Chennai corridor:

+91 88616 22859 | +91 80886 85440

Call or WhatsApp. Our team responds the same working day. If you prefer, use the enquiry form on this page and mention your cabin size, intended use, and delivery address.
